receipt_generation_basis: committed B1 tree at certified commit; receipt self-files are explicitly excluded
verification_tool: Python hashlib.sha256 with os.stat byte counts
verification_command: inline Python walk of every result-record path/bytes/sha256 entry, de-duplicated by path; missing/size/hash mismatch count emitted
scope_statement: Every linked path carrying a path/bytes/sha256 pin in the result record was byte-verified. Receipt self-files are not pinned in the record, so there is no mutual hash cycle. Untracked user-owned paths are outside the declared B1 scope.
